data.description: Parked from ticket b5f8-d3f9-39d9-4195 (bounded auto-resume for the completion close gate), whose resumption deliberately passes NO frontier. Steering a resumption away from already-searched places (or toward where credited evidence was found) requires an argument-level tool-call transcript that the verifier telemetry does not currently carry. This idea covers (1) the capability question — extending verifier telemetry to record tool-call arguments per evidence-search step — and (2) the extractor design on top of it that would digest a failed attempt's search frontier into a hint for the next attempt. Cache seeding alone proved sufficient in the live 8d74 re-run, so this is an optimization, not a correctness gap; it stays an idea until the telemetry capability question is answered.
data.title: Search-frontier handoff for completion-verifier auto-resume (capability question)
